comparator.serving_path: raw audio through the bf16 mmproj, -c 49152 -np 3

id_rule: <sealed id>@ts2; the sealed key is recovered by splitting on '@', so the paired join against the sealed comparator is exact and no id collides with the comparator population's
rule: exactly 2.0 s of digital silence appended to the sealed clip -- 2.0 x the file's OWN sample rate in zero samples; nothing is removed, no sealed sample is altered, the sample rate is never changed and no parent container is re-decoded that the sealed comparator did not itself send

rule_implementation.note: the Earnings-22 dev1500 builder's own transform, imported and pinned by content, so all four carriers' variant bytes are produced by the same rule and the same code

sealed_clip_trailing_silence.measured_by: analysis.e22_clip_boundary.energy_margins at its committed version, on the SEALED samples (not the variant): 20 ms frames, active = frame RMS within 35 dB of the clip peak and above the absolute floor

split_role_basis: The SAME frozen 400-row Audio2Tool discovery split (50 per tier over all eight tiers) the sealed official-protocol replication flew, re-encoded by one deterministic rule from the sealed WAV bytes. The split was already exposed by A0 and stays discovery. No evaluation query text, gold tool name, argument or tool registry row is opened here.
